 Weathering 101 Seminar at Q-Lab Europe Bolton, UK 
Weathering 101 Seminar at Q-Lab Europe Bolton, UK
Join Q-Lab's technical experts for our most requested seminar - Weathering 101. We will present in-person on Wednesday, 01 October starting at 9:00 am BST. 
Location:
Q-Lab Europe
Express Trading Estate, Stone Hill Road, Farnworth, Bolton, England BL4 9TP, United Kingdom
Cost: £125.00
Agenda: Available here
Q-Lab's technical experts will provide practical, easy-to-understand information explaining the fundamentals of weathering and lightstability testing.
Attendees will learn:
Forces of Weathering: how sunlight, heat, and water can damage materials
Outdoor weathering testing: natural and accelerated
Laboratory weathering testing: xenon-arc and fluorescent UV tester technologies
Weathering test programs: selecting test standards and evaluations
Correlation: determining relationships between lab and outdoor testing with Case Studies
Attendees will also have the opportunity to discuss their applications and ask questions. Lunch, refreshments, and course materials are provided. Be sure to register soon, as spaces are limited!
*Please note: we are unable to process credit card payments at this time. In order to save your seat you will need to provide a PO Number. Thank you.

 Weathering and Lightfastness Testing
 Weathering Test Standards 
International Test Standards for Weathering
Q-Lab's robust line of accelerated weathering test chambers are capable of meeting a variety of internationally recognized standards from organizations such as ASTM and ISO. To view all of the standards our accelerated weathering test chambers can meet, head to our Standards Selector Tool. Visit our FAQ page to see some of the most common questions we receive regarding test standards for weathering.
